$comment: Per-declaration assurance for Broiler.JSeal. Product projects only: the three packable libraries (the reference-free contracts and the two engine providers). Broiler.JSeal.Tests, the diagnostics/ probes and eng/package-consumer do not ship and are not listed, so they are not covered. No source here is third-party-derived (the component was extracted from Broiler.HtmlBridge and uses Broiler.JS and Broiler.VM only as NuGet packages), so there are no spdxOverrides. HUMAN_REVIEW.md is a hand-written review record and stays as it is; the generated per-unit record goes to HUMAN_REVIEW.units.md.
regenerateCommand: dotnet run --project Broiler.Code/src/Broiler.Code.Review.Cli -c Release -- assurance generate --root Broiler.JSeal
